|===

OpenSSL: its cells differ by a few bytes whatever the operation: each fetches its algorithm by name from OpenSSL's default provider (link:https://docs.openssl.org/3.5/man7/crypto/[OpenSSL 3.5's crypto(7), algorithm fetching]), and a static link brings the provider's algorithms with it, not the operation's alone.

libsecp256k1: a row that recovers a key or computes with a public point other than the generator (`recover`, MuSig2's session, a silent payment's output) links the precomputed table of libsecp256k1's variable-time multiplication too, built at window 15 natively and on WASI and at window 2 on Emscripten, the small tables (link:https://github.com/bitcoin-core/secp256k1/blob/master/configure.ac[libsecp256k1's configure.ac, the precomputed tables' trade]).
